segments.text: I have seen the comments asking if the
Samsung Trifold is actually useful or
not, which first of all, it's incredible
that I can have a literal 10-in tablet
in my pocket, but okay, fine. Here's the
best part. This is a full screen video
on a regular phone. Pretty big, right?
This is what we're used to. Here is that
same video on the unfolded fold screen.
And it's a great screen. It's huge, but
clearly the square is not making that
much of a difference. So, this is the
same video on the Samsung Trifold, and
the difference is absolutely massive.
This is a real 16 by11 10-in landscape
tablet that you can literally fold and
put into your pocket. It just makes so
much more sense than the square. Also,
this has me way more curious about what
Apple's going to maybe do with their
first folding iPhone
